_comment: ngsolve dg_methods#7 (Python abs() is not defined on ngsolve.la.BaseVector; go through .FV().NumPy()). Run 2026-08-06 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, L2 order 2. type(gfu.vec) really is ngsolve.la.BaseVector, so the quoted message names the class in play; abs(gfu.vec) and the claim's own max(abs(gfu.vec)) spelling both raise TypeError carrying the literal text. The FV().NumPy() route returns a finite peak that matches a plain Python max over the same coefficients to 1e-13 and has exactly ndof entries. The compound spelling gfu.components[i].vec.FV().NumPy() works on a real L2*L2 product space and the per-component maxima bound the whole-vector maximum. Mutation: replacing abs(gfu.vec) by abs(gfu.vec.FV().NumPy()) removes the TypeError and the fixture fails on abs_raises_typeerror.
